node.title: Linear-difference local records are translated complementary divisors
node.statement: For a fixed base support S0 with locator L0 and complementary-domain locator U, depth-t local records of side width e are in exact bijection with pairs (B,H) such that B is a monic degree-e divisor of L0, B+H is a monic degree-e divisor of U, H is nonzero, and deg H<=e-t-1. On a cyclic multiplicative coset every d=1 record is coefficient-primitive. Over F_17^* one fixed five-point base has three distinct same-prefix neighbours whose reduced locator difference is the same 6X+10, so H is not an injective record key.
